rate_table_note: Rates are the single premium tables in 31.13.03.10A(1) (retroactive, 30-day waiting period) and A(2) (not retroactive, 30-day elimination period), by months repayable (9 to 120) and maximum number of benefits per occurrence (6, 9, 12, 18, 24; for 12 months only 6 and 9 are printed), and the monthly premium schedule in B. Family leave coverage may add up to 4 percent (C). Rates per $100 of outstanding balance per month must be consistent with these (E, formula M = R x 10 x P). The chapter took effect January 1, 2003 (29:12 Md. R. 934); .10 has not been amended since. Also saved: archive/MD/2026-11-21_47009c61.html (MD-COMAR-31.13.03.html).
source_title: COMAR 31.13.03.10 Prima Facie Premium Rates for Credit Involuntary Unemployment Insurance (Library of Maryland Regulations)
summary: Rates in force: Maryland's prima facie credit involuntary unemployment rates in COMAR 31.13.03.10, per $10 of monthly benefit: single premium tables by loan term and maximum benefits (for example $14.095 retroactive and $9.887 not retroactive for 60 months and 12 benefits) and monthly premium rates ($0.268 and $0.188 for 12 benefits). They apply to premiums charged on or after the chapter's effective date, January 1, 2003.
